title: Not good value; not healthy
text: Very few of the snacks are what i'd consider "healthy."  4 or 5 were bags of potato chips (including two bags each of two different kinds of chip).  There are also candies and cookies.  Additionally, the value is poor - these snacks should not cost more than $1 on average.  I bought this once, and the surprise/variety was fun, but i won't be buying again.
label: neutral
